i/o: in: goal seed (the owner's request) plus every artifact it names, and any on-disk salvage those name; out: planning/facts-brief.md (goal restated, constraints, salvage inventory, credentials/preferences inventory)
in: planning/facts-brief.md; out: planning/design.md (one chosen approach + the full milestone list with per-milestone done-criteria)

in: planning/design.md + planning/facts-brief.md; out: planning/draft-plan.md (every milestone detailed, the execution declaration (execution-goal name, lane, roster, workflow/sheet), execution seats/workflow, permission-envelope + credential-name sections, per-seat interact flags, declared outputs, relaunch budget) + planning/execution-contract.md (the born goal's goal.md body) + for a one-off plan planning/current/ (manifest.csv, seats/<seat>/ prompt+task pairs, bindings.json) — the seat set the birth mints with --goal-local
in: planning/draft-plan.md + planning/design.md + planning/facts-brief.md; out: planning/review-package.md (findings list tagged blocking/non-blocking, revised plan, approval package)

in: planning/review-package.md + planning/design.md + planning/bound-commit (the hash the goal's leader recorded when it accepted plan-reviewer); out: planning/approval-digest.md (composed AND sent to the owner as the approval ask, via one `coordinate send owner --type note --approve-commit <bound commit>` row)
